description.value: Haida House at Tllaal is a Haida-owned Indigenous cultural tourism lodge nestled along the banks of the Tlell River on Haida Gwaii, offering 10 lodge rooms and 12 oceanside cabins across 50 acres of river and ocean frontage. The property specializes in authentic Haida cultural adventures, with access to forest trails, a fruit orchard, and beach, on one of Canada's most remote and ecologically distinct archipelagos. Reaching it requires either a ferry from Prince Rupert or a flight to Sandspit, making it a genuine end-of-the-road destination for touring cyclists on Haida Gwaii.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at haidatourism.ca/haida-house confirms an active, Haida-owned lodge and cabin resort in Tlell with 10 lodge rooms and 12 oceanside cabins, accepting bookings. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. A phone number (1-778-357-0336) appears on the dining subpage but is absent from OSM; the dining room is noted as 'closed to the public — Stay tuned for re-opening dates,' suggesting temporary closure of that facility only.
concerns: Phone number (1-778-357-0336) found on website dining subpage but absent from OSM record.
Dining room is noted as 'closed to the public — Stay tuned for re-opening dates,' indicating a temporary closure of the restaurant; lodge itself remains open for stays.
OSM address (2087 Beitush Road) is not explicitly corroborated by the website, which only confirms the Tlell community location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable accommodation in a remote cycling destination on Haida Gwaii; website confirms active lodge and cabin bookings.
enrichment_extras.notes: The gift shop on-site stocks snacks, fresh baking, and convenience items, which may be the only on-property food option for visiting cyclists while the dining room remains closed to the public.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site casual dining room specializing in tide- and farm-to-table cuisine with fresh seafood, charbroiled meats, local seasonal vegetables, and homemade desserts
